newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila firms invite bids for 53,000 T U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Manila firms invite bids for 53,000 T U.S. wheat.

text.p: Philippine flour millers invited tenders on Wednesday for 53,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, traders said.
"The buyers invited us to submit bids for 41,000 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat with a 14 percent protein content and 12,000 tonnes of western white wheat," one trader told Reuters.
Traders said they were advised that the proposed wheat orders were for late November to early December deliveries.
"The bids will be opened at 4 p.m. (0800 GMT)," said one trader.
Executives of Philippine flour mills said on Friday they would enter the market this week if prices fall to "interesting levels".
Wheat prices dropped overnight in Chicago and Minneapolis, where Philippine flour millers buy their wheat requirements, on local and fund selling.
